name: Eleni Papadopoulos
bio:
Eleni's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying mechanical engineering at the National Technical University of Athens, she stumbled upon a Formula Student competition, sparking a lifelong passion for precision and speed. After graduating, she honed her skills at a local automotive repair shop, quickly earning a reputation for her meticulous attention to detail and uncanny ability to diagnose and fix complex mechanical issues. Driven by an unwavering desire to work at the pinnacle of motorsport, Eleni relentlessly pursued opportunities until she secured a position with Ferrari AF Corse. 

As a machinist, Eleni is known for her relentless pursuit of perfection. She approaches every task with a visionary outlook, constantly seeking innovative ways to improve the performance and reliability of the team's machinery. Her colleagues often joke that she speaks 'machine language,' as she possesses an almost intuitive understanding of how each component functions and interacts within the larger system. Eleni thrives under pressure, viewing the intense demands of motorsport as a challenge to push the boundaries of her abilities and contribute to the team's success.

physical.description: Eleni is a woman of average height with a focused gaze and strong, capable hands.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Insists on using a specific brand of Italian-made lubricant for all her machining tasks.
Listens to traditional Greek folk music through headphones while working, claiming it helps her concentrate.
